# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

This project is a place to build and collaborate. Be direct, be honest, and treat others with basic respect. Harassment, personal attacks, and bad-faith behavior will get you removed.

## What this covers

GitHub Discussions, issues, pull requests, and any other space under this project.

## Reporting

If something happens that you think violates this, open a private security advisory or email the maintainer directly. Reports are handled confidentially.

## Enforcement

Maintainers will handle violations at their discretion — this may include warnings, comment removal, or banning from the project.
